provenance.mission_energy: 10 km shared across every stage; station-only reset; same loaded/empty rate
provenance.fixed_corridor_cost: not charged: new model selects facilities and paths, no corridor binaries
provenance.locker_capacity: not present in the new delay-node path formulation
provenance.pickup_discount: paid on self-pickup orders, included in terminal expected cost

pickup_timing.timing_rule: same-day payment < fetch <= delivery; xi=(fetch-payment)/60 hours

provenance.pickup_expectation: Exact expectation under the empirical marginal distribution; no optimization scenarios
